text:
$ROST back on the board

Held the anchored VWAP from the Jun 26 volume-spike anchor for 13 straight sessions. Entry 235.80, target 289.95. A close below 199.70 kills it, no debate. Historical, not a promise.

$ROST back on the board

ROST is -1.6% off its 52-week high (242.81). Entry 235.80, target 289.95. A close below 199.70 kills it, no debate. Historical, not a promise.

$NVDA into the week

Closed 207, up 2% on the week, back above the 20-day (203), still under the 50-day (209). About 12% off the highs, mid-range for the year. Into next week, the 50-day at 209 is the level I want reclaimed. On the watch list, not a call.

$TSLA into the week

Closed 313, down 18% on the week, under both the 20- (389) and 50-day (403). Down near the low end of its 52-week range. Into next week, watching whether 303 holds or gives way. Watching, no position.

$AAPL into the week

Closed 333, roughly flat on the week, holding above both the 20- (314) and 50-day (306). Sitting right up at its 52-week high. Into next week, the 20-day at 314 is the first line to hold. On the radar — tracking it, not touching it.

$AMD into the week

Closed 522, up 5% on the week, back under the 20-day (533) but still over the 50-day (508). About 10% off the highs, still upper-half of its range. Into next week, getting back over 533 is what flips it back constructive. Levels, not advice.

$PLTR into the week

Closed 123, down 7% on the week, under both the 20- (128) and 50-day (132). About 41% off the highs, in the lower third of its range. Into next week, the 20-day at 128 is the first hurdle back. On the watch list, not a call.

$MSFT into the week

Closed 382, down 3% on the week, under both the 20- (387) and 50-day (399). About 29% off the highs, in the lower third of its range. Into next week, the 20-day at 387 is the first hurdle back. Watching, no position.
